status: All 10 steps executed and produced artifacts. Panel reconstructed from scratch (provided repo was empty).

environment.gpu_note: Task is econometric (small panel regressions and low-order VARs on a 51x44 panel); no GPU-capable step.

data_reconstruction.sources: FRED API (BLS CES/SAE state total nonfarm employment 1939+ = {POSTAL}NAN; BEA per-capita personal income 1929+ = {POSTAL}PCPI; Census/BEA population = {POSTAL}POP; BLS LAUS unemployment/labor-force 1976+ = {POSTAL}UR/{POSTAL}LF; national aggregates PAYNSA, UNRATENSA, A792RC0A052NBEA, POPTHM, CLF16OV)
known_gaps: Manufacturing production-worker average hourly earnings 1947-1990 (the paper's headline wage series, from printed 'Employment and Earnings', SIC basis): NOT reconstructable from any free modern API -- BLS SM AHE series begin 2001 (NAICS), Census ASM API 1997, BEA industry wages need a registration key and begin 1969, QCEW open-data begins 1990. None overlap 1947-1990. Per-capita personal income (which the paper connects to wages via Barro & Sala-i-Martin) used as the reconstructable relative-wage proxy in wage-convergence/persistence/ADF/univariate/bivariate steps; every such field is labeled.

State unemployment before 1976: paper backfilled 1970-75 from LMA rates (provided by H. Courtney) normalized to the 1976 CPS; LAUS only begins 1976. Pre-1976 relative unemployment, participation, le and lp are NOT reconstructable. Unemployment/participation analyses run on 1976-1990 (univariate unemployment on 1978-1990; trivariate VAR on 1978-1990).
CPS worker-characteristic-controlled wage (1979-1989) and city house prices: not reconstructed (out of scope / archival).
documented_approximations: le/lp built by normalizing establishment nonfarm employment to LAUS employment in base year 1976 (per appendix); working-age population approximated by resident population (state CPS not-in-labor-force by year unavailable free).
Trivariate VAR: unemployment response approximated as -le; participation as lp.
